rules.statement: When the Plaintiffs claiming as Trustees institute an action to safeguard or assert rights to the Trust property and the question at issue is whether the title to the Trust property is vested in the Plaintiffs or in the Defendants, the Plaintiffs are not entitled to maintain the action without first obtaining a vesting order under Section 112 of the Trusts Ordinance.
